body:
Maria CS: Heads-up — Kestrel (renewal flagged low) asked for a hands-on weekend bootcamp to finish migration and ramp their ML infra. Can we run a 2-hour evening session for APAC customers next weekend? Need host + backup + a short agenda.
Ari Eng: I can host if we keep it focused (migration checklist + sample inference tuning). Sat or Sun evening SGT works for me.
Priya CS: Sat evening SGT would be best for the customer's team. Can we include a short section on Dedicated vs Private deployment tradeoffs? They keep asking about cost and data controls.
Liam AE: FYI customer health sig: renewal conversation in 3 weeks. This bootcamp is high priority. I can send invites once we lock time.
Rohan SuccessOps: Let's run a quick availability poll. I can create one with timezone-aware options. Also suggest capturing feedback in a short form post-session to surface blockers for renewal.
poll-bot: Poll created: "Kestrel weekend bootcamp — preferred slot (SGT)" — options: Sat 19:00-21:00, Sat 20:00-22:00, Sun 19:00-21:00. Vote here: https://poll.internal/abcd1234 
Maria CS: Agenda draft (very short):
```
- 10m intro + success criteria (CS)
- 30m migration checklist walkthrough (Eng)
- 40m hands-on lab: model deploy + KV/cache validate (customer + Eng pairing)
- 20m performance tuning + batching tips (Eng)
- 20m Q&A + next steps (CS/AE)
```
Maria CS: Need volunteers for breakout pairing (2 Engs) and someone to take notes & collect feedback. Also: confirm recording permission from customer.
Ari Eng: I can be primary host and take the performance tuning section. Rohan can you assign one more Eng? I can do pairing for the hands-on lab too.
Rohan SuccessOps: @Ari Eng adding @Devon Eng as backup host. Devon is on-call Saturday but can swap. Devon ok?
Priya CS: Recording is fine per customer, but they prefer we keep recordings internal. Will add that note to the invite. Also recommend a short pre-read: one-pager on token-cost controls + quick start commands.
Liam AE: I'll draft the invite copy and include the pre-read link. Also adding the renewal playbook snippet to follow-up actions.
Maria CS: Can someone set up a tiny sandbox workspace with an example repo and credentials (ephemeral) for the pairing lab? We should avoid touching their production.
Ari Eng: I can spin up a sandbox and push a small repo. ETA: Friday EOD.
Rohan SuccessOps: Poll results (automated): Sat 20:00-22:00 SGT wins (60%). I'll book provisional calendar for that slot and tag it "tentative — awaiting host confirmation".
poll-bot: Option results: Sat 19:00-21:00 (25%), Sat 20:00-22:00 (60%), Sun 19:00-21:00 (15%).
Priya CS: Sat 20:00-22:00 SGT works for the customer too. +1 on breakout rooms and internal-only recording.
Liam AE: Noted. I'll send calendar invite to customer + internal with Chatham time conversions.
Maria CS: Quick feedback capture plan: 3-question post-session form (confidence to go to prod, top blocker, any pricing concerns). Can someone create the form?
Rohan SuccessOps: I'll create the form and wire the responses to the renewal tracker. Also will flag any blocker marked as "pricing" or "security" for immediate AE follow-up.
Ari Eng: Small checklist for hosts: sandbox ready, repo link, runbook for rollback, recording toggle set to internal-only, breakout rooms created. Sending that checklist in a sec.
Maria CS: This looks good. Thanks everyone. I’ll hold off sending invites until Ari/Devon confirm host availability and sandbox is up.
Priya CS: I'll confirm customer's permission for the recording and post-read prepped tonight.
Liam AE: I'll prep renewal playbook notes and be on the call.
Rohan SuccessOps: Marking this high-priority on the renewal board. Will follow up if votes shift. :thumbsup:
Maria CS: Final ask — capture one highlight and one risk in the follow-up doc right after session so we can include it in the renewal exec summary.
Ari Eng: ✅
Priya CS: ✅ will do.
Maria CS: Thanks — leaving this thread open for any last-minute swaps.
